mainEntity.name: What is a crypto KOL marketing agency and who is it for?

acceptedAnswer.text: A crypto KOL (key opinion leader) marketing agency manages creator campaigns: identifying and vetting influencers, writing briefs, coordinating content publishing and reporting results. It is for Web3 and crypto projects that want community growth, wallet-connect activity or protocol awareness that paid media and PR alone cannot reach. The right fit is a team or operator who vets creators before booking them, not one who simply has a roster of names.

mainEntity.name: How much does a crypto KOL campaign cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: Creator fees vary by tier: nano creators ($200–$1.5K per post), micro ($500–$5K), mid-tier ($10K–$30K) and macro ($25K–$100K+). Agency or operator management on top of creator fees runs $5K–$12K per month for a fractional senior operator, or $15K–$45K per month at a full-service agency. A single launch sprint, covering three waves and creator fees for a mid-tier roster, typically runs $15K–$40K all-in.

mainEntity.name: Which platforms and regions do you cover for crypto KOL campaigns?

acceptedAnswer.text: Primary platforms: YouTube (long-form review), X (threads and spaces), Telegram (community posts) and TikTok (short-form). Regional coverage includes English-language global creators, Korean (BloomingBit ecosystem), Japanese (CoinPost adjacent), Vietnamese, Hindi and Arabic-speaking creators. APAC and MENA campaigns are run with native-language briefs and local audience checks, not translated versions of a global brief.

mainEntity.name: What does the crypto KOL fraud audit actually check?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before any creator is booked, the audit scores follower authenticity (bot-detection tools cross-referenced against engagement rate), audience-overlap against your existing community and other creators on the roster, prior-campaign history to flag creators who ran competing projects in the last 90 days, and comment-sentiment quality to catch creators whose engagement is driven by giveaway farms. The audit report is shared with you before any outreach begins.

mainEntity.name: How do I start a crypto KOL campaign with Shilika Jain?

acceptedAnswer.text: Send a short brief through the intent form with your launch date, target audience and budget range. You will get a reply within 24 hours with an initial creator tier recommendation and a fraud-audit scope. Alternatively, book a 30-minute call to map the campaign structure live. No agency deck, no introductory sales call chain.
